title: JANUS HENDERSON GROUP PLC 8-K Filing — 2026-04-17
summary: Janus Henderson Group plc shareholders approved the merger agreement with Jupiter Company Limited at an extraordinary general meeting on April 16, 2026, with 127.3 million votes in favor against 400,566 votes against. The merger would take the company private and change its name to Janus Henderson Group Ltd. Completion remains subject to regulatory approvals and client consents.
key_points: Janus Henderson shareholders voted to approve merger with Jupiter Company Limited (Parent) and Jupiter Merger Sub Limited
Merger Proposal passed with 127,304,509 votes for, 400,566 votes against, and 81,429 abstentions
Record date was March 9, 2026 with 154,075,608 shares outstanding and entitled to vote
Adjournment Proposal also approved (122.6M for, 4.9M against, 287K abstentions) but not needed
Non-Binding Compensation Advisory Proposal passed with 124.9M votes for
Merger agreement dated December 21, 2025, amended March 24, 2026
Remaining closing conditions include required regulatory approvals and client consents
